pr_title: stm32: uart: dma circular mode from device tree
pr_body:
Allow usage of DMA circular buffering mode from device tree.

The DMA buffer had to be reset when full which lead to missed bytes.
It is now possible to configure the DMA buffer in circular mode by setting the `cyclic` bit.
With the `cyclic` bit, both half and full transfer interrupts are triggered, allowing the user to use the received data while some other bytes are being received in the background in the other half.

To know which interrupt has been triggered, the `status` parameter is used in the DMA callback.
Within the DMA callback, `dma_get_status` is not used by default but the `status` parameter cause by the time the function is called, some new bytes could have been received and we don't want to handle them when processing the interrupt. `UART_RX_BUF_RELEASED` and `UART_RX_BUF_REQUEST` are not used when circular mode is used.

It is still possible for users of the DMA module to force the usage of the circular buffer by setting field `source_reload_en` of `struct dma_block_config` to `1`.

Fixes #43308

Hey
I notice the same behavior as @Jeepgoing 

From [my comment on the PR](https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/pull/30917#issuecomment-1286508166) adding the async feature: 
I am trying to use UART at 1Mbps but it seems like the buffer replacement when DMA buffer is full is taking too much time so I am loosing bytes. One operation I want to perform in the callback is to copy the buffer into another one to reconstitute a message. (500+ bytes). Message length isn't fixed.
I think we should use the circular mode for DMA instead of the normal one and call `UART_RX_RDY` on half and full buffer so that we never miss any byte as we don't have to manage RX DMA buffers anymore once RX is enabled.

As a quick workaround, I tried reloading the DMA config with a new buffer each time the UART goes into idle between messages as there I have more time, and I don't miss any byte anymore.

review_comments:
This currently breaks transmitting with spi_ll_stm32. When calling spi_write() consecutively, I get the following error:
```
<err> dma_stm32: dma stream 1 is busy.
<err> dmamux_stm32: cannot configure the dmamux.
```
stream->busy is not cleared in `dma_stm32_irq_handler` because the direction is `MEMORY_TO_PERIPHERAL` and it is also not cleared in `dma_stm32_stop` because `stm32_dma_is_enabled_stream()` returns false (the hardware channel has already stopped).

Please remove `stream->direction == PERIPHERAL_TO_MEMORY`
Btw, shouldn't we also check `config->head_block->source_reload_en` here?
